category_title: High-achieving students who dominate discourse with fast, vague, and decontextualized explanations
scenario_title: Thinking aloud during the Fraction Maze task
minimal_context: The student and tutor are working on the Fraction Maze task and discussing their reasoning.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's work on the Fraction Maze task. I will start by sharing my reasoning for the first section.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Writes feverishly and raises her hand while the tutor is sharing reasoning)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Next, we need to look at the fractions in the second row.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Struggles to contain her enthusiasm, making inappropriate sounds and gestures while the tutor is talking)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and share what you are thinking.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drones in a very abbreviated, decontextualized, and disconnected way) Sevennnn, wait, sevennnn, twenty-eight, no you can’t even do seven!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's work on the Fraction Maze task. I will start by sharing my reasoning for the first section.

STUDENT: (Writes feverishly and raises her hand while the tutor is sharing reasoning)

TUTOR: Next, we need to look at the fractions in the second row.

STUDENT: (Struggles to contain her enthusiasm, making inappropriate sounds and gestures while the tutor is talking)

TUTOR: Go ahead and share what you are thinking.

STUDENT: (Drones in a very abbreviated, decontextualized, and disconnected way) Sevennnn, wait, sevennnn, twenty-eight, no you can’t even do seven!

context.environment: Whole-class and small-group discussions of mathematical tasks
context.social_setting: Group setting while others were representing their thinking on paper

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When going through her thinking out loud
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Droned in a very abbreviated, decontextualized, and disconnected way that was probably not meant to be followed by others
related_quotes: Sevennnn, wait, sevennnn, twenty-eight, no you can’t even do seven!

behavior_patterns.condition: While others were engaged in discourse and sharing their reasoning
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Wrote feverishly, had her hand raised, and made inappropriate sounds or gestures
